links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Scoring and ranking companion software is the gating next step
content:
The next steps recorded are to score and rank companion software candidates, and to create demo integrations and presentations — in that order.

Sequencing selection before construction is the right way round given the economics: the demo is the expensive artefact and everything downstream derives from it, so choosing the wrong companion tool wastes the marketing, the landing pages and the outreach built on top of it.

The candidates named across the session are the IFC ecosystem and Speckle in construction, UMH and Paperless in manufacturing, and openEHR in healthcare, with banking and insurance left open. A separate primary-source screen has since assessed six adjacent tools and produced verdicts, which is the same exercise applied to a different candidate list.
description: The immediate action is to score and rank companion-software candidates before building demo integrations, making selection a deliberate step rather than a by-product of enthusiasm.
